description: This file defines the class OLERead for parsing and reading data from OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) compound files, used by Microsoft Office documents. It includes methods for reading the file, accessing streams, and handling the internal structure of OLE files.

classes.name: OLERead
classes.description: A class for reading and extracting streams from an OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) compound file, commonly used in older Microsoft Office documents.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the specified OLE file, verifies its format, and loads its internal structure for access.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves a data stream from the OLE file by its index, handling both small and big streams.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Internal method that reads a full sector chain starting from a given sector.

methods.name: readPropertySets
methods.description: Internal method to parse directory entries within the OLE file.

methods.name: getInt4d
methods.description: Static helper method that reads 4 bytes from a data string at a specified position as a 32-bit integer.
